I created a service on andoria-b1a3 that resets the DUT before the nightly. Part of the service restarts platformd. During the update DUT portion of the night workflow `apt-get upgrade -y` get run an upgrades everything available on the apt server including the bitfile. Wednesday night the new bitfile was upgraded and last night the service restarted platformd and the upgrade was applied to the cards.

I am going to do an `sudo apt-mark hold archer-ia860m-es-standard` to pin the bitfile to the known good version.

Soak Failures:
• The soak recorded 16 streaming errors against a zero-error allowance, from 2026-10-02 11:50:08.472946 through 11:51:57.473906 UTC. Failures affected GPT-OSS 120B (5), Llama 8B (4), Llama 3B (4), and Llama 70B (3). The count remained at 16 after the 11:52:02 sample.
